name: pilot_v1
purpose: first improvement comparison; pilot only, not a paper non-inferiority claim
task_selection_basis: H0 measured cost + observed headroom (pass / agent_error / cheap failure); pre-registered before candidate evaluation

ood.reason: TB2.1 only; pilot_validation and holdout are in-distribution disjoint guards; true OOD needs another benchmark

stop_rules.floor_guard: if H0 and candidate are both 0 on >=7/8 pilot_dev tasks, declare not measurable and stop
stop_rules.dev: stop if candidate loses any H0-passing pilot_dev task, or net task wins < 2
stop_rules.validation: run only after dev signal; stop if validation net wins < 0 or >1 task regresses
stop_rules.holdout: never use for tuning; final-only, separate budget
stop_rules.max_budget: abort the pilot if direct API spend exceeds 20 CNY

notes: pilot_dev and pilot_validation are disjoint from holdout
cancel-async-tasks is smoke, used only as a sensitivity signal, not as a holdout claim
no task appears in both pilot_dev and pilot_validation
